content.title: Kal test hai?
content.subtitle: Taiyari ho gayi. Ab bas chhoti galtiyon se bachna hai.

steps.title: ID check karo
steps.detail: Wahi ID le jao jo registration mein di thi. Naam ki spelling bhi match karo.

steps.title: Centre ka rasta dekho
steps.detail: Wahan pahunchne mein kitna time lagega, aaj hi check karo. Kal jaldi niklo.

steps.title: Poori neend lo
steps.detail: Raat bhar padhne se kuch naya nahi aayega. Fresh dimaag zyada kaam aata hai.

steps.title: Halka revision
steps.detail: Naya topic mat kholo. Apne notes aur purani galtiyan dekh lo.
steps.tip: IELTS kit ke Failure Patterns ek baar padh lo.

steps.title: Bag raat ko pack karo
steps.detail: ID, confirmation email aur paani. Jo allowed hai, wahi rakho. Subah ki bhaag daud bachegi.

caption:
Kal IELTS, TOEFL ya GRE hai? Aaj ye 5 kaam kar lo, kal tension kam hogi 👇

1. ID check
2. Centre ka rasta
3. Poori neend
4. Halka revision
5. Bag raat ko pack

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
